title: Sync Batch Orchestrator v2 and compact operator UI
description: Upgrade the AI Studio workspace to the reviewed Batch Orchestrator v2 from GitHub main. Source of truth: machxanht/BridgeChatgpt main. Sync these files exactly from GitHub: server/batchOrchestrator.ts, server/batchRoutes.ts, server/githubCommandBus.ts, src/components/IdentityBanner.tsx, src/components/MissionControlView.tsx, tests/batchOrchestrator.test.ts. IMPORTANT: do NOT replace package.json and do NOT wholesale-replace server.ts because this Studio workspace has deployment-specific startup compatibility changes. Instead patch the existing Studio server.ts while preserving its current working startup style: import batchRouter and startBatchOrchestrator; call startBatchOrchestrator after database initialization; mount app.use('/api/batches', requireAuth, batchRouter); add batch_orchestrator: 'ready' to successful /health and 'degraded' to error /health. Do not modify data/bridge.sqlite or existing task history. After changes run npm run lint and npm run build, restart Preview, verify /health status ok and batch_orchestrator ready, then open Mission Control and confirm: account/project identity is one compact line; a running batch becomes the main hero; normal technical details stay secondary. Do not Publish yet. Report result through Studio Relay and move this task to review.
